motif: One thin derrick mast on every building, topped with a single glowing Chama de Poço orange flame lamp. The orange appears only at that tip and nowhere on the body.

buildings.why: The tripod and tall harpoon rail make the tallest, thinnest outline of the race.
The card sinks the whole rim into dirty sand. The pale pan reads as a bright hole.
The wide cave mouth under a chimney is the arch, grown from the Ogre Den with tank drums for a base.
It keeps the Gnoll Tent's low dome and adds a tall flare chimney. The red separates it from the cream tent next to it.
The broad canvas shelter is a low dome wrapped around a tripod.
The low hanging ring of wire and sticks is the crown shape. The Harpy chain keeps it and grows it.
The long, low Sandkin Burrow shape widens into a broad rupture. The upright glass fan sits on top, in green to set it apart.
The Harpy Nest chain ends in a large inclined ring nest. Pale wings set it apart from the green burrow before it.
The narrow wire bowl is a deeper ring on a tall pole. Grey separates it from the bone-white matriarch nest.
The excavation cave under a drill-pipe lintel is the base arch of the Ogre chain.
The low pen spreads in several directions around one pump post.
Stacked coils make the star arms taller and broader around a crooked reel mast. The steel blue separates it from the rust-red yard.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: The thorny still has several spiked pipes under one tall exhaust pipe. Teal is the race's single cool, bright hue.
Round shell-eggs and a sump form drum shapes. Black pitch stands out against the teal still.
The long, low dune hollow under a short windsock mast is the base shed shape.
The buried manifold and rail spur step up in tiers to one vent stack. Concrete is the only grey-white mass, set against yellow sand.
